integrity.proof_basis: Direct reduction of the full trilinear relative identity on a 4-dimensional basis, symplectic quotient rigidity, a primitive linear polynomial irreducibility argument, and exact quadratic-form/semisimple-matrix finite-field enumeration.
integrity.unproved_limit: No classification of weight-zero operators, other 3-Lie algebras, or the competing Rota–Baxter convention.
integrity.verification: Full symbolic defect reconstruction; all 65536 ambient operators over F2 checked; all 3^9 and 5^9 quotient matrices checked; all 4^9 matrices checked over F4.

scientific_limitations: The classification concerns the central four-dimensional 3-Lie algebra with sole independent bracket [e2,e3,e4]=e1.
The weight must be nonzero. A concrete zero-weight operator violates derived-line preservation.
The identity is the adjoint-action relative Rota–Baxter identity of Definition 2.6 in the primary paper, not the distinct classical nonzero-weight convention.
The hypersurface assertion is for the reduced solution variety; no claim about unreduced scheme structure.
The closest broader 2026 article was accessible in abstract form only, giving residual literature-coverage risk.
title: Complete nonzero-weight relative Rota–Baxter operators on a central four-dimensional 3-Lie algebra
